heroSubtitle: Small-molecule nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT) inhibitor — supplied as a research reagent, not a peptide
description: 5-Amino-1MQ is a small-molecule inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT), an enzyme that consumes methyl groups and NAD+ precursors. It is used in cell and animal research models investigating adipocyte lipid handling, NAD+ availability and NNMT-dependent methylation flux. Because it is not a peptide, it is supplied as a powder for laboratory reconstitution rather than as a lyophilized peptide vial standard.

faq.question: What is 5-Amino-1MQ and is it a peptide?
faq.answer: 5-Amino-1MQ is a small-molecule quinolinium compound (CAS 685079-15-6), not a peptide. It is a nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT) inhibitor used as a laboratory research reagent.

faq.answer: Supplied as a powder in 10-vial kits. Store sealed, desiccated at 2–8°C, protected from light. Reconstitution solvent depends on your protocol; the COA states the batch solubility result.
